threads.body: The centralization misses `instrumentation/okhttp/okhttp-3.0/library/src/http2Test/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/okhttp/v3_0/OkHttp3Http2Test.java:29-36`, which still builds exact request and response selectors. Consequently, the HTTP/2 base-test matrix neither uses this shared selector nor exercises header-name enumeration, contrary to the stated “every call site”/whole-matrix goal. Please switch both HTTP/2 call sites to `AbstractHttpClientTest.TEST_HEADERS` as well.

replies.body:
Addressed in 944946ffe47671f542c2511396897a1b0e787c43.

Analysis: The HTTP/2 test used exact selectors while the equivalent HTTP/1 test used the shared wildcard selector. Reusing `AbstractHttpClientTest.TEST_HEADERS` keeps both protocol variants aligned and exercises name enumeration in the HTTP/2 matrix.

Upsides: The HTTP/2 tests now cover the same wildcard selector behavior as the other shared client tests. The change also removes duplicate selector construction.

Downsides: No material downside identified.
